reviews.review_title: Decent, but a couple issues that ruin it
reviews.review_description:
Hi, I wrote the review on the supermarket game, which I love. I really wanted to love this one too, but there are a couple of problems.
1. Getting the fish out. Either I don't know, and their were no instructions, or their is a glitch preventing me from being able to do so. When I have a customer who wants a fish, I have to wait forever for them to get mad and leave. 
2. It's almost impossible to scrub the poo spots away. They're too low. If you're playing seated you can't reach them. You either have to skip that part or keep going into your headset settings and adjusting your height. That is really annoying. 
Aside from those issues, for $2.99 it's not a bad game at all. I liked it even with having to work around the issues. If everyone priced their games realistically like this, they'd get better reviews.
